title: Novel
lead: Paste or import your novel. AI only fills in what the camera cannot show and never changes the plot; you decide on every suggestion.

empty.title: No novel imported yet
empty.lead: Import a .txt or .docx. Chapters are found from headings like “Chapter 3”; a text without headings is split by length. Not a word of the text is changed.

importDialog.title: Import a novel
importDialog.lead: Supports .txt (UTF-8 or GBK) and .docx, up to 30 MB. Check what was found before importing.
importDialog.foundParts: No chapter headings; split by length into {{chapters}} parts · {{chars}} characters
importDialog.replace: This replaces the current text ({{filename}}): the old one stays in the history, and the bible, suggestions, episodes and scripts all become out of date.
importDialog.rights: I own the adaptation rights to this novel, or have permission
importDialog.unchanged: Same text as the current one; nothing changed

gate: Confirm the text, write the script

source.title: Source text
source.diffHint: Highlighted text marked “+” is an adopted addition.

suggestions.title: Suggestions
suggestions.rewriteLabel: Tell the AI how to change this one
suggestions.rewritePlaceholder: E.g. no trench coat; she wears a work jacket today
suggestions.rewriteDone: The suggestion for paragraph {{n}} was rewritten as asked ({{model}}).
suggestions.acceptAllDone: Adopted every suggestion that was not ignored.
suggestions.empty: No suggestions yet. Click Rerun above to let the AI look for gaps.

bible.title: Extracted story bible
bible.lead: From the text and adopted additions; used by the script and asset steps
